text:
tasha_sales: Kicking off thread for AcmeCorp POC 3 they want SSO (Okta SAML), SCIM provisioning for ~50k users initial import, RBAC via groups, domain proofing for tenant isolation, and a short Dedicated burst for load testing. Need quick answers on provisioning flow + pricing.

leo_se: Quick questions: will Acme use Okta Group Push or SCIM-based group sync? Also are they expecting OKTA to push roles as SAML attributes?

emily_acme: We o group push today for apps. For Redwood we prefer SCIM provisioning for users + groups. We can export CSV for initial import. Okta will push role attribute in SAML assertion too.

leo_se: OK. Recommended POC plan: 1) initial bulk -> presigned S3 CSV upload (we do a server-side ingest to avoid 50k SCIM calls); 2) enable SCIM delta sync for day-to-day (scim.users.read/write + scim.groups.read/write scopes); 3) map Okta group names -> Redwood roles via mapping table.

nate_sec: Security items from questionnaire: 1) assertion encryption required? We support encrypted assertions (AES-GCM + RSA-OAEP) if SP metadata contains KeyDescriptor for encryption. 2) SCIM transport: hosted = TLS with bearer token, Dedicated/Private = mTLS option. They requested mTLS for provisioning 3 that implies Dedicated or Private.

emily_acme: We asked procurement for a hosted trial first. If hosted doesn't meet latency we will convert to Dedicated. If hosted SCIM lacks mTLS we may ask for exception but procurement prefers mTLS for provisioning.

leo_se: Two operational notes: a) for group->role mapping we accept a JSON mapping config or attribute-mapping in SAML assertion (e.g., Roles claim). b) If you want JIT provisioning on first SAML login, we can create user entries and assign default role; but SAML attribute-based role mapping is better for SSO-only flows.

leo_se: example mapping (paste into UI or API):

```json
[
  {"okta_group": "acme-admins", "redwood_role": "admin"},
  {"okta_group": "acme-engineers", "redwood_role": "engineer"}
]
```

nate_sec: Also note audit requirements: Acme requested 12 months of audit logs. Hosted default retention is 90 days; we have an Enterprise Logs add-on for 12 months (s3 export + read APIs). For Dedicated we can set 12 months by config.

emily_acme: Good. Also legal asks: data residency EU for PII, KMS-managed keys for tenant data at rest, and SOC2 + pen test artifacts.

nate_sec: We can offer EU Dedicated or Private deployment. KMS integrations: hosted supports customer-managed KMS via cloud-provider CMKs if on Dedicated; Private supports HSM. SOC2 report link and redacted pentest summary will be attached after approvals.

infra-bot: [infra-bot] SCIM token created for acme-poc (scope: scim.read,scim.write) - expires in 30d. URL: https://api.redwood.ai/scim/acme-poc

tasha_sales: Pricing ask: 2-week Dedicated burst for load test (target 2k TPS sustained for 48h). Do we have a short-term daily rate or pro-rated monthly? Procurement wants firm number to include in PO.

leo_se: Finance prefers pro-rated minimum + daily burst cap. I'll scope a conservative mGPU count for 2k TPS and provide daily rate. Recommend including an overage per-1k TPS.

nate_sec: One more security config detail: assertion encryption requires us to import SP encryption key into our key rotation schedule if we need to decrypt on infra side. Confirm whether Okta will send encrypted assertions or just signed + encrypted nameid.

emily_acme: Okta will encrypt assertions. We'll provide SP metadata and want to test encrypted assertions in the POC.

leo_se: Action items: 1) Tasha - get SP metadata and S3 access + CSV sample. 2) Nate - prepare security artifact links (SOC2, pentest summary, encryption standards doc) and confirm mTLS gating. 3) Leo - draft POC ops doc (Okta config steps, mapping JSON, SCIM endpoints). 4) Finance - Tasha to request burst quote (48h).

tasha_sales: Sending SP metadata request to Emily now. Will ask for S3 role/temporary creds for CSV upload or we can give a presigned PUT URL.

emily_acme: We'll provide an IAM role with limited S3 put access and the SP metadata by EOD. Also please include a short note on SLA for Dedicated during burst.

nate_sec: SLA note: Dedicated has 99.9% uptime SLA for committed capacity; burst is best-effort unless committed. We'll include that in the commercial note.

leo_se: If anyone needs sample Okta app settings I can paste the ACS URL / EntityID format here. We'll also test group push -> SCIM group sync mapping in our staging tenant.

tasha_sales: Thanks all. I'll update CRM and post POC acceptance criteria. Ping here once security docs are attached. :thumbsup:
